notes: Added 5 stories covering schema, logic, API exposure, tests, and integration for Enrollment Status.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for enrollment status
Added core logic for enrollment status extraction and normalization
Added API exposure via Evaluate Care facade
Added unit tests for enrollment status logic

EVAL-CT-M2-S1.title: Define Enrollment Status Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M2-S1.description: Define a normalized schema for clinical trial enrollment status (e.g., recruiting, active, completed, unknown) and map raw ClinicalTrials.gov statuses into this contract.

EVAL-CT-M2-S2.title: Implement Enrollment Status Extraction and Normalization Logic
EVAL-CT-M2-S2.description: Extract enrollment status from ClinicalTrials.gov API responses and normalize values into the defined schema, including handling edge cases like missing or uncommon statuses.

EVAL-CT-M2-S3.title: Expose Enrollment Status via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M2-S3.description: Integrate normalized enrollment status into the clinical trials response returned by evaluate_care_facade so it is available to downstream consumers.

EVAL-CT-M2-S4.title: Unit Tests for Enrollment Status Normalization
EVAL-CT-M2-S4.description: Create unit tests validating correct mapping of raw ClinicalTrials.gov statuses into normalized categories, including edge cases and unknown values.

EVAL-CT-M2-S5.title: Integration Test for Enrollment Status in Clinical Trial Results
EVAL-CT-M2-S5.description: Validate that enrollment status flows from ClinicalTrials.gov API through service logic and facade into final response payload for clinical trial search.
